name: CIFAR-10
description: The CIFAR-10 dataset consists of 60,000 32x32 colour images across 10 mutually exclusive classes, with 6,000 images per class. Subdivided into 50,000 training images and 10,000 test images, collected by Alex Krizhevsky, Vinod Nair, and Geoffrey Hinton.

license.name: License not specified by publisher
license.notes: The cited publisher page provides downloads and requests citation, but no standard dataset license or commercial-use grant was established in this review. Commercial use remains unknown; public download availability is not a license.

source_references.notes: Canonical dataset distribution page maintained by Alex Krizhevsky.

verification.notes: 2026-10-29 scoped review: Rechecked 60,000 images, the 50,000/10,000 split, and the 163 MB Python archive on the Toronto publisher page. License remains unspecified. Raw data files were not downloaded or inspected.
